description: Source file implementing downlink data flow for user plane in a radio communication system, including functions for generating parameters, handling resource grid data, and building network packets.

classes.name: data_flow_uplane_downlink_data_impl
classes.description: Class handling the downlink user plane data flow, packet generation, and resource management.

methods.name: generate_dl_ofh_user_parameters
methods.description: Creates parameters for downlink Open Fronthaul user data based on slot, symbol, PRB, and compression settings.

methods.name: generate_ecpri_data_parameters
methods.description: Creates eCPRI IQ data parameters with sequence ID and EAXC ID.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message
methods.description: Enqueues a section type 1 message for a given resource grid context and grid.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message_symbol_burst
methods.description: Processes resource grid symbols, fragments data, and enqueues messages.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message_symbol
methods.description: Builds and packs a symbol message into a buffer, including Ethernet and eCPRI headers.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns metrics collector instance (null in this implementation).
